name: Rate Set
description: The set a governed rate belongs to (konsol#348). Every Historical Equity Rate names its set; a Statutory Rate Sheet publishes under the set flagged Is Actuals, a Constant sheet under CONSTANT. Exactly one set is flagged Is Actuals: the actuals translation and the close gate read that set alone, and refuse by name while none is flagged. A budget or forecast names its own set on its Budget Cycle, so actual, budget and forecast rates for one currency pair and period never collide.

fields.label: Rate Set
fields.description: The code, and the document name: what a rate, a Budget Cycle and the warehouse's rate_set column carry. Upper-case letters, digits, _ and - only, 1 to 40 characters (A-Z, 0-9, _, -): it is passed to the warehouse whole. Never changed for you.

fields.label: Is Actuals
fields.description: The one set the actuals translation, the close gate, Pre-fill from ERP and the rates screens read. At most one Rate Set may carry it; a second is refused by name. While none is flagged, every actuals reader refuses rather than assume a set.
